features: Explicit exact-scope MCP authorization with no default grants
MCP application context, approved paths, planning, approved deterministic execution, targeted exploration, reporting, memory proposals and job status/cancellation
Shared application, QA, learning, navigation and policy services
Real Applications, Configuration and aggregate Overview dashboard screens
securityReview: No MCP approval, onboarding, arbitrary artifact/path read or expectation-rewrite tool
Per-action exact application/environment/build/role/tenant/feature-flag grants; multi-role operations validate every role
Job results referencing a base build require that base build read permission
Approved exact plan and normal action/fixture policies required for execution
Codex context construction/isolation source unchanged and synthetic gate reverified
Viewer remains loopback-only, bearer-protected and Host/Origin checked; mutations require same-origin JSON
No reusable access token published or committed
Onboarding accepts credential references only and cannot silently repurpose existing identities
Artifact quotas, retention and raw-trace restrictions preserved
resolvedDevelopmentFailures: Protocol test initially used an unavailable SDK in-memory transport export; replaced with actual compiled CLI and official stdio client
Nested subprocess spawning blocked inside sandbox; real stdio tests passed with approved subprocess access
MCP report lacked explicit deterministic-execution metadata; added providerUsed=false
Cross-build job-result disclosure regression test first failed, then passed after authorization fix
knownLimitations: MCP is local stdio only; no remote HTTP/OAuth deployment
Explicit owner CLI/dashboard review required for approvals
Provider planning still requires validated Codex CLI and current CLI authentication
Onboarding creates new immutable scope identities; it does not edit historical identities or support automatic MFA
Abruptly interrupted jobs/runs still require operator reconciliation; no automatic crash resumption
Artifacts and screenshots remain local; raw traces are never exported through MCP
